endpoint: Certify whether the default queue needs at least ceil(0.10 B) extra checks to match the alternative at B.
test: Use the same exact worst-case-null terminal rejection rule, audit cap and proportional final sample allocation as the previous fixed audit. Sample within each exclusive set without replacement.
rule: After each distinct check, evaluate the most and least favorable possible completions of the prespecified final samples. Stop as soon as all completions have the same terminal decision. No optional p-value comparisons.
primary_schedule: Interleave in proportion to the fixed final allocation. Prioritize the challenger on exact ties.
evaluation: Compute exact expected checks and final certificate probabilities on the frozen 17 targets and six paired references. Repeat all budgets 5/10/20 percent and both directions. Include screen controls and full shared-budget replay separately.
